title: The Buddy Bears
description: They are the Buddy Bears! They never have a fight. Anyone who disagrees is never, ever right. If you have a point of view, then keep it out of sight!
quote: We’re going to teach you how to be sweet and nice and always agree with everyone.
altHero: the Buddy Bears, three bears in bowties and hats
alt2: a Buddy Bear with an abacus
alt3: a Buddy Bear letting birds fly out of a woven basket
alt4: another Buddy Bear with a bird on his finger
